A '''Clone X trooper''' was active at [[Tantiss Base]] around the [[Standard year|year]] [[18 BBY]]. The [[Clone X trooper]], along with [[Sniper CloneX3]], [[Sniper CloneX4]], and [[Sniper CloneX5]], was activated by [[Doctor|Dr.]] [[Royce Hemlock|Hemlock]] to capture [[Clone Force 99]] who had infiltrated Tantiss Base. The trooper was present in the [[Tantiss Base training room]] when [[Echo]] and a group of freed [[Cloning|clone]] [[prisoner]]s arrived. The trooper was [[Death|killed]] by [[Vik (clone)|Vik]].

==Biography==
Created as a [[human]] [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], the Clone X trooper once served in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic|Army]] as a [[clone trooper]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="ClonesData" /> During the [[skirmish on Wayland]], as the trooper turned the corner, blaster raised, they were shot multiple times by [[Vik (clone)|Vik]], [[Death|killing]] them.<ref name="TCHA" />

==Equipment==
The Clone X trooper wore [[armor]] similar to the ones worn by other members of [[CX squad]]. Although this trooper had [[goggles]] on his helmet and used a double-barreled [[blaster pistol]].<ref name="TCHA" />
